description: A scheduled agent run that announces itself in Slack: every period it posts a top-level message, then starts the agent run tagged with that message's ts so slack_reply answers in its thread.

slack_channel_id.label: Slack Channel Id
slack_channel_id.description: Channel ID to announce in (e.g. 'C0123ABCDEF') -- the real id, not '#name'.

asset_selection.label: Asset Selection
asset_selection.description: The agent asset (and anything downstream, e.g. a slack_reply asset) to run each period: explicit key list, the Dagster selection DSL, '*', or a bare fnmatch glob, resolved against sibling assets.

announce_text.label: Announce Text
announce_text.description: Text of the top-level Slack message posted when a run starts. The agent's reply lands in this message's thread.

first_run_delay_hours.label: First Run Delay Hours
first_run_delay_hours.description: Hours after the first tick before the first run. Unset = one full period, so the period starts at 'now' and a deploy never fires a run right away. 0 = fire on the first tick.

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's 'xoxb-...' token (needs chat:write; invite the bot to the channel).

extra_tags.label: Extra Tags
extra_tags.description: Additional run tags, e.g. {'team': 'data-eng'}. slack/* tags are set by the sensor and win on a clash.

set_isolation_disabled_tag.label: Set Isolation Disabled Tag
set_isolation_disabled_tag.description: Tag each run dagster/isolation: disabled (run in-process on the code server). Off by default: a scheduled run is not latency-sensitive.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: 'RUNNING' or 'STOPPED' -- initial status of the sensor.

skip_in_branch_deployments.label: Skip In Branch Deployments
skip_in_branch_deployments.description: Skip every tick inside a Dagster+ branch deployment (DAGSTER_CLOUD_IS_BRANCH_DEPLOYMENT=1), which would otherwise announce and run a second copy.
